issue.title: test_plan_file_mode_archives_prompt_link hardcodes month '202608' in a prompt path fixture
issue.description: Discovered as a pre-existing failure while running just check/just test-scoped for unrelated plan 202609/v2_adoption_unwedges_v1.md; not caused by that plan's diff.

task_type_fields.impact: The test's Resolver.prompt_url asserts prompt_ref == "prompts/202608/rollout.md" and archive_plan_file now derives the current month's prompt path (prompts/202609/rollout.md, since today is 2026-09-03), so the assertion inside the resolver fails and is wrapped into PlanFileWorkError. Fix: derive the expected month dynamically (e.g. from a frozen/injected clock or datetime.now(UTC).strftime("%Y%m")) instead of the hardcoded literal '202608'.
